items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Louia Taylor left the band of Erskine Hawkins. The interviewee responds only to the question about Erskine Hawkins ('Yeah. He got the band and came over to the Quality.'), providing no information about his personal relationship with Louia Taylor.

ctx.x: This is May 22nd, 1978, and we're talking to Paul Howard, with Buddy Collette.

Okay, Paul, a couple of questions here. After the Quality Serenaders left the Cotton Club, it said something about Paul did some reshuffling and added new men. But now some of the people here -- and made some famous Victor recordings -- Tuba Jack was added, and what does it say, I guess Lionel Hampton, Leon Hemford, Louis Taylor, and let's see -- oh, it says something like Louia Taylor left the band of Erskine Hawkins. Now, was it a period when Erskine
Hawkins was in Los Angeles that you knew him as a musician?
